# 🎙 会议看板

> 本文件依赖 **Dataview** 插件。若未安装，本页不渲染，但所有会议笔记本身仍完整可读。

## 最近 30 场

```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID
  file.link AS 会议,
  date AS 日期,
  duration AS 时长,
  speaker_count AS 人数,
  status AS 状态
FROM "会议纪要"
WHERE type = "meeting-note"
SORT date DESC
LIMIT 30
```

## 待校对（有未命名说话人）

```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID file.link AS 会议, date AS 日期, unnamed_speakers AS 未命名人数
FROM "会议纪要"
WHERE type = "meeting-note" AND status = "待校对"
SORT date DESC
```

## 按项目聚合

```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID file.link AS 会议, date AS 日期, tags AS 标签
FROM "会议纪要"
WHERE type = "meeting-note" AND contains(tags, "项目/数据平台迁移")
SORT date DESC
```

## 本月统计

```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID
  length(rows) AS 场次,
  sum(rows.duration_sec) / 3600 AS 总小时数
FROM "会议纪要"
WHERE type = "meeting-note" AND date >= date(today) - dur(30 days)
GROUP BY true
```
